sentences.text:
Another Counsel for Applicant :- Anuradha Arora Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and Sri Rajeev Shukla, learned State Counsel.
2.
In view of the proposed order, notice to opposite party no.2 is dispensed with.

3. This petition has been filed for quashing of the order dated 09.03.2023 which is passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gonda in Case No. 8193 of 2023 (State Vs. Vineet Kumar and Others)
being Case Crime No. 681 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 507 IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Gonda, which is pending in the court of CJM, Gonda.

sentences.text: 4. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioners has prayed that direction may be issued to the court below for disposal of bail application of the petitioners expeditiously, if possible, on the same day, in the light of dictum of the Apex Court in re; Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & Anr, Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No(s).5191/2021.

sentences.text: 5. Learned State Counsel has no objection to the aforesaid prayer.

6. Therefore, it is provided that if the petitioners surrender within four weeks from today and move application for bail, the same shall be considered and disposed of by the court below expeditiously in the light of the dictum of Hon'ble Apex Court in re; Satender Kumar Antil (supra), strictly in accordance with law.
7. Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of finally.
